hero.subtitle: Dial *789# from any phone. Our USSD system guides you in 60 seconds and alerts emergency services immediately — no internet, no smartphone required.

how_it_works.title: How it Works: USSD Dialing
how_it_works.step1_desc: No internet or smartphone required. Access the triage system instantly using standard USSD across all African Telcos.
how_it_works.step2_desc: The interactive menu guides the user through the F.A.S.T (Face, Arms, Speech, Time) check in their preferred language.
how_it_works.step3_desc: If critical, an immediate alert is pushed to the nearest hospital's dashboard.
